title: Design System: Boston Services Auto Repair

display.purpose: Hero headline; same cut for the letterhead name and footer sign-off.

headline.purpose: One red condensed-caps heading per copy section.

title.purpose: Line-item names, address name, side-note heads.

body.purpose: Running text in ballpoint ink; 16px under 600px.

label.purpose: Preprinted field captions, legends, column and stub heads, uppercase red.

entry.purpose: Courier Prime for every filled-in value: inputs, RO number, hours, captions, customer remarks.

shadows.name: loose-paper
shadows.purpose: Clipped photos, tables, map mat, hours stub.

motion.name: ease-paper
motion.purpose: Shared ease: tilted papers and stamps straightening, tick draw, button lift.

motion.name: tick-draw
motion.purpose: Blue tick wipes in left to right when a box is checked.

motion.name: typewriter-reveal
motion.purpose: Hero typed entries reveal in steps on load, staggered 380ms; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: carbon-flash
motion.purpose: A ticked line item flashes blue like a carbon transfer.

motion.name: state-quick
motion.purpose: Color, fill and border state changes.

components.css: :host{--red:#b8141f;--blue:#1d3a9a;--blue-ink:#182f78;--paper:#fffefa;--canary:#f4e49e;--red-soft:rgba(184,20,31,.32);--red-faint:rgba(184,20,31,.14);--blue-soft:rgba(29,58,154,.14);--steel:#7d8794;--shadow:0 1px 1px rgba(40,30,0,.12),0 10px 24px -8px rgba(40,30,0,.35);--face:'Archivo','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--type:'Courier Prime','Courier New',monospace;--ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-btn-ink{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:52px;padding:0 22px;background:var(--blue);color:var(--paper);border:0;border-radius:3px;cursor:pointer;font:800 1rem/1 var(--face);letter-spacing:.02em;transition:transform .15s var(--ease),background .2s} .ds-btn-ink:hover{background:#17307f;transform:translateY(-1px)} .ds-btn-ink:active{transform:translateY(1px)} .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible{outline:2px dashed var(--red);outline-offset:3px}

components.css: :host{--red:#b8141f;--blue:#1d3a9a;--blue-ink:#182f78;--paper:#fffefa;--canary:#f4e49e;--red-soft:rgba(184,20,31,.32);--red-faint:rgba(184,20,31,.14);--blue-soft:rgba(29,58,154,.14);--steel:#7d8794;--shadow:0 1px 1px rgba(40,30,0,.12),0 10px 24px -8px rgba(40,30,0,.35);--face:'Archivo','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--type:'Courier Prime','Courier New',monospace;--ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-field{display:block;padding-top:14px;max-width:420px;background:var(--paper)} .ds-field>span{display:block;font:800 .72rem/1.2 var(--face);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--red)} .ds-field input{width:100%;border:0;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--red-soft);background:transparent;font:700 1.12rem/1.4 var(--type);color:var(--blue);padding:4px 2px 5px;border-radius:0;transition:border-color .2s,background .2s} .ds-field input::placeholder{color:#55639c;font-weight:400} .ds-field input:focus,.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--blue);background:var(--blue-soft)}

narrative.overview:
The whole site is the shop's own multi-part repair order. A white original sheet sits on canary "customer copy" ground, a pink copy follows behind a perforation, and everything on it is printed in exactly two inks: preprint red for what the form says, carbon blue for what was written on it. Preprinted labels are condensed grotesk capitals; anything a person "filled in" (order numbers, hours, captions, quotes, typed entries) is a typewriter face in blue. The material grammar is office paper: hairline red rules, empty checkboxes, dotted perforations, rubber stamps, and real photographs paper-clipped onto the sheet at a slight tilt.

Density is that of a working form, not a brochure. Sections are "copies" separated by perforations; services are line items in a ruled table; reviews are customer remarks typed onto ruled lines with a red margin. The red, white and blue come straight from the building (red canopy, white band, blue bay doors), so the form is the shop's own stationery rather than a generic theme.

The world rejects the stock auto-shop template: no full-bleed photo hero with overlaid headline, no grid of icon service cards, no gradients, no glossy chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks only, red and blue, on canary, pink and white paper stocks.
Condensed heavy capitals for preprint; Courier Prime for every filled-in value.
Hairline red rules, square checkboxes and perforations instead of cards and dividers.
Photographs are clipped prints with a white border, a steel paperclip and a 1 to 1.5 degree tilt.
Depth is paper on paper: soft warm drop shadows, never glass or glow.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Every mark is red or blue. Red is what the form printed; blue is what someone wrote. If a new element needs a third hue, it is a different document.

rules.name: The Carbon Rule
rules.body: Blue appears where a person acted: a typed entry, a tick, a focus, a selected line. Do not use blue for decoration.

rules.name: The Preprint vs. Filled-In Rule
rules.body: Archivo capitals for what the shop printed; Courier Prime in blue for what was written in. Never set a label in Courier or a value in condensed caps.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Condensing is done with the Archivo width axis (62 for display, 75 for titles and stamps), never with faux scaling or letter-spacing squeeze. Display tracking stays at 0.

rules.name: The Paper-Only Rule
rules.body: Only things that are paper get shadows. Buttons, fields and stamps are printed or inked on the paper and stay flat to it.

dos: **Do** print every new mark in either preprint red or carbon blue on canary, pink or sheet-white stock.
**Do** set preprinted captions as red Archivo 800 caps at 0.72rem with 0.12em tracking, and any filled-in value in blue Courier Prime.
**Do** separate sections with a perforation strip and content with red hairlines rather than cards.
**Do** present photographs as clipped prints: white border, steel paperclip, a 1 to 1.5 degree tilt, a typed caption and any required credit.
**Do** let loose papers and stamps straighten to 0 degrees on hover with the shared ease (cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)).
**Do** keep every tap target at 44px or taller and honor reduced motion by dropping transitions and the typing reveal.
donts: **Don't** add a third ink. Status, success and emphasis must be expressed in red or blue.
**Don't** round paper. Sheets, fields, tables, checkboxes and photos stay square; only the ink button, bar call and stamp take a radius.
**Don't** give buttons, fields or stamps a drop shadow; shadows belong to paper lying on paper.
**Don't** use a full-bleed photo hero with overlaid text or a grid of icon service cards.
**Don't** use gradients, glass, glow or neutral grey shadows.
**Don't** reproduce the Boston Red Sox mark; use the original B roundel emblem.
